text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Labour programme would spell disaster for Malta, prime minister says. The programme insists that Malta should not join the European Union and will withdraw Malta's membership in NATO's Partnership for Peace programme.
- Opposition Labour leader Alfred Sant, seeking to take over the government in October 26 elections, says the Malta Labour Programme is led by a new generation of leaders who are forward looking.
- Sant says a Labour government would draw up long-term plan for Malta Drydocks recovery.
- Prime minister sees Nationalist Party as guarantor for progress in education and health.
